questions.question: Which of these classes is used to create an object whose character sequence is mutable?
questions.explanation: Mutable strings are dynamic strings. They can grow dynamically as characters are added to them. stringbuilder class supports those methods that are useful for manipulating dynamic strings.

questions.question: Select the namespace/namespaces which consists of methods like Length(), Indexer(), Append() for manipulating the strings.
questions.explanation: The system.text namespace contains the Stringbuilder class and hence must include using system.text for manipulating the mutable strings.
